effect_description.DIAMOND_STORM: Gain 40 DEF, receive -70% critical damage. On explosion deal: 20 TRUE and 3 seconds ARMOR_BREAK. Collect up to 3 weather rocks.

effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_ICY_ROCK: Every 5 seconds, steal 3 SPEED from all enemies within RANGE. Attacks deal 20% of the user's SPE_DEF as additional SPECIAL ON_HIT.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_SMOOTH_ROCK: At the start of the fight, gain 30% of DEF and SPE_DEF as max. HP. Every 3 seconds, deal 1% of max. HP as TRUE to ADJACENT enemies.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_BLACK_AUGURITE: All incoming damage has a chance to be reduced based on your current CRIT_CHANCE. For every 100% CRIT_POWER, the damage is reduced by -15% (max -70% damage reduction).

effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_ELECTRIC_QUARTZ: When receiving THUNDER_STRUCK_DAMAGE or an allied Pokémon withtin a 2-tile radius uses its ability, gain +5 SPEED and +10 SHIELD.

effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_STICKY_GLOB: Every held item has a [30, LK]% chance to be copied to the BUG clone
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_ECLIPSE_STONE: At the start of the fight, gain 100% of DEF as AP and 50% of DEF as starting PP.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_PEARL_STONE: The user casts Surf when hit by the big TIDAL_WAVE.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_ELDER_CRYSTAL: Attacks have [1,LK]% chance per STAR on your board to deal the targets remaining SHIELD and current SPEED as PHYSICAL, SPECIAL or TRUE ON_ATTACK.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_DISTORTION_SLATE: ON_ATTACK, [5, LK]% chance to inflict the target and ADJACENT enemy Pokémon with a random BOARD_EFFECT.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_FOSSIL_FRAGMENT: Fossil revive with HP instead of SHIELD. If hit by METEOR_DAMAGE, increase user ATK by 100% base ATK.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_CLOUD_ORB: When the user is affected by a negative status effect, lose 20% of current DEF for the next 5 seconds and gain RUNE_PROTECT for 5 seconds.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_PEAT_BLOCK: When the user is KO'd, distribute its current DEF and SPEED equally among allies within a 2-tile radius.
effect_description.CRYSTALLISE_BLOSSOM_SHARD: After casting its ability, the user regains 5% of its max PP for each ADJACENT ally.

effect_description.FAIRY_WIND: Pick one of three wands among CONFUSE_WAND, PETRIFY_WAND, SLOW_WAND, SLUMBER_WAND

effect_description.MOON_FORCE: Pick one of three wands among WARP_WAND, SWITCHER_WAND, WHIRLWIND_WAND, TUNNEL_WAND. FAIRY Pokémon gain 5 LUCK.

effect_description.ETERNAL_LIGHT: Also increase base DEF and SPE_DEF by 50% and give RUNE_PROTECT for 8 seconds
effect_description.QUICK_FEET: WILD Pokémon get +20 SPEED, and can now be found in shops at every stage (8% base chance + 0.5% for each WILD STAR on board).
effect_description.BERSERK: Once below 30% HP, gain 30 SHIELD and double these ATK and SPEED buffs for 3 seconds.

effect_description.SHAPELESS: Ally team gains 3 SPEED and 6 HP per unique active synergy
effect_description.ETHEREAL: Ally team gains 5 SPEED and 10 HP per unique active synergy

passive_description.COMATOSE: Always under SLEEP. Immune to BURN, POISONNED, FREEZE and PARALYSIS. When a SOUND try to wake this Pokémon up, it sinks deeper into its dream, gaining 5 AP.

passive_description.MAWILE: Gain one stack for each KO. Mega evolves after 20 stacks.

status_description.BURN: Deals 5% of max HP as TRUE every second. Reduce healing and FREEZE duration by 50%.
status_description.SILENCE: Prevents casting abilities and gaining PP
status_description.FATIGUE: Reduce PP gain from all sources by 50%
status_description.POISONNED: Deals 5% of max HP per stack as TRUE every second. Can stack up to 3 times by default.
status_description.PROTECT: Protects from any source of damage, but prevents healing and PP gain. Enemies will avoid targeting a protected unit.
status_description.SLEEP: Prevents moving, dodging or attacking. Receiving attacks reduces the duration of the effect.
status_description.CONFUSION: Force to change target all the time and sometimes target itself
status_description.RAGE: Double all damage, get +80 SPEED. Half healing, SHIELD, FREEZE and SLEEP durations, and lose PROTECT. All units become RAGE after 35 seconds of fight.
status_description.RESURRECTION: Prevents KO once, restoring to base max HP. Synergy buffs, item stacks and statuses are reset upon resurrection.
status_description.PARALYSIS: Reduce the effectiveness of SPEED by 50% and prevents dodging attacks
status_description.POKERUS: Every 2.5 seconds, gain 1 ATK and 10 AP before infecting 2 ADJACENT allies with POKERUS
status_description.ARMOR_BREAK: Reduce the effectiveness of DEF & SPE_DEF by 50%
status_description.CHARM: Prevents attacking the target and forces to get closer to it
status_description.CURSE: KOs the cursed Pokémon after some time. Applying curse on an already cursed Pokémon triggers KO immediately.
status_description.POSSESSED: Fight for the other team temporarily. Becomes CHARM if the target is the only enemy remaining
status_description.LOCKED: Prevents moving and dodging and sets RANGE to 1
status_description.ELECTRIC_FIELD: Increase damage dealt by ELECTRIC Pokémon by 20%
status_description.PSYCHIC_FIELD: Increase damage dealt by PSYCHIC Pokémon by 20%
status_description.GRASS_FIELD: Increase damage dealt by GRASS Pokémon by 20%
status_description.FAIRY_FIELD: Increase damage dealt by FAIRY Pokémon by 20%

synergy_description.NORMAL: NORMAL Pokémon and their ADJACENT allies gain SHIELD when combat starts, and can craft various scarves.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.GRASS: GRASS Pokémon heal and produce berries over time. 40% of overheal is gained as max HP.
synergy_description.FIRE: FIRE Pokémon have a chance to BURN their enemies, and gain ATK after every attack.
synergy_description.WATER: WATER Pokémon generate more PP and can be fished with a rod.
synergy_description.ELECTRIC: ELECTRIC Pokémon basic attacks can trigger two additional attacks.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.FIGHTING: FIGHTING Pokémon block a flat amount of damage on every hit received. After 10 hits blocked, throw the melee target away, destroying their SHIELD.
synergy_description.PSYCHIC: PSYCHIC Pokémon gain additional AP and attract Unowns.
synergy_description.DARK: DARK Pokémon's critical hits are more powerful and more frequent. Melee Dark Pokémon jump to the farthest target reachable. The STRONGEST Melee  DARK Pokémon leaps away with the target once below 50% max HP. One more Pokémon triggering this effect for each synergy step.
synergy_description.STEEL: STEEL Pokémon deal a percentage of their damage as TRUE and give 3 DEF to your whole team when activated.
synergy_description.GROUND: GROUND Pokémon dig holes on board in between stages, and gain stats based on the depth of the hole they start in. They sometimes find buried items at max depth (5 stages).
synergy_description.POISON: POISON Pokémon have a chance to POISONNED their target for 4 seconds ON_HIT, and gain extra PP ON_ATTACK. When POISON Pokémon are KO'd, they burst and deal a part of their remaining PP as SPECIAL to all ADJACENT enemies.
synergy_description.DRAGON: DRAGON Pokémon amplify synergies and gain more stats when fully evolved.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.FIELD: When a FIELD Pokémon is KO'd, all the other FIELD Pokémon are healed and gain SPEED
synergy_description.MONSTER: MONSTER Pokémon can FLINCH their opponents for 3 seconds ON_ATTACK. Every time they get a KO, they gain stats, heal and grow in size.
synergy_description.HUMAN: HUMAN Pokémon heal for a percentage of the damage they deal with attacks and abilities, and can learn a new ability with TMs.
synergy_description.AQUATIC: AQUATIC Pokémon mitigate status afflictions for all your team. After 7 seconds, a TIDAL_WAVE cleans up negative status and field effects, heals your AQUATIC allies, and knocks back and damages enemies.
synergy_description.BUG: At the start of combat spawns a copy of your STRONGEST BUG Pokémon.
synergy_description.FLYING: FLYING Pokémon fly away when they fall under a certain amount of HP unless affected by PARALYSIS, FREEZE, LOCKED or SLEEP. Your whole team gives SPEED when activated. Benched Pokémon can be used as postal service. They get paid with seeds. Higher rarity carriers tend to bring back items and components, while lower rarity ones are more likely to find gold on their way home.
synergy_description.FLORA: When a FLORA Pokémon is KO'd, a Flower Pot blossoms and you collect RICH_MULCH. Higher STAR units give more mulch, which can be used to evolve your Flower Pots.
synergy_description.FAIRY: FAIRY Pokémon use wands to deal additional SPECIAL and various effects with their attacks.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.ROCK: ROCK Pokémon gain DEF, better resist to critical attacks, and can adapt to weather. When ROCK Pokémon are KO'd they explode, deal TRUE damage and ARMOR_BREAK all ADJACENT enemies
synergy_description.GHOST: GHOST applies various curses on opposing Pokémon. GHOST Pokémon have a [15,LK]% chance to dodge attacks and apply SILENCE on hit when synergy active.
synergy_description.ICE: ICE Pokémon have [20,LK]% chance to FREEZE the enemy for 2 seconds after a hit and give SPE_DEF to your whole team.
synergy_description.FOSSIL: At 30% HP, FOSSIL Pokemon awaken their primordial power, gaining SHIELD and ATK.
synergy_description.SOUND: SOUND Pokémon emit a cry when they use their abilities, waking up sleeping allies and giving them bonus stats.
synergy_description.ARTIFICIAL: ARTIFICIAL Pokémon give tools and gain ATK, AP and SHIELD when holding items.
synergy_description.BABY: BABY Pokémon have a chance to bring you Pokémon Eggs to comfort you after a defeat. Chance stacks with losing streaks.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.LIGHT: LIGHT Pokémon reveal a spotlight on the battlefield. The Pokémon standing in the spotlight at the start of combat gains unique bonuses.
synergy_description.WILD: WILD Pokémon are only found during PvE encounters stages when synergy is not active (8% base chance). Their attacks have [25,LK]% chance to inflict WOUND for 3 seconds.{{additionalInfo}}
synergy_description.WILD_ADDITIONAL: Current chance to find a WILD Pokémon: {{wildChance}}%
synergy_description.AMORPHOUS: AMORPHOUS Pokémon are extremely flexible and lack their own shape. Your team gains HP and SPEED by activating a wide variety of synergies.
synergy_description.GOURMET: GOURMET Pokémon can be equipped with a CHEF_HAT. Chefs will cook up their Signature Dish between fights and feed ADJACENT allies, giving them various buffs and effects.

QUEST_REROLL.name: Quest: Reroll
QUEST_REROLL.description: Gain 10 free rerolls. After rerolling 50 times, gain a REPEAT_BALL.

QUEST_GROW.name: Quest: Grow
QUEST_GROW.description: Gain a BERSERK_GENE. The first time an ally reaches 1000 HP in a fight, gain a DYNAMAX_BAND.

QUEST_SHINE.name: Quest: Shine
QUEST_SHINE.description: Gain a LIGHT_BALL. The first time you activate Light 7, gain a SHINY_STONE.

QUEST_EPIC.name: Quest: Epic
QUEST_EPIC.description: Gain a 1 STAR Epic Pokémon and 6 XP. The first time you fight with 7 Unique, 7 Epic, or 7 Ultra Pokémon fielded, gain an EVIOLITE. (Scyther does not count)

QUEST_EXPAND.name: Quest: Expand
QUEST_EXPAND.description: Gain 10 XP. After fielding 8 Pokémon that all have a sell price of 4 or more at once, gain a GOLD_BOW.

QUEST_ASCEND.name: Quest: Ascend
QUEST_ASCEND.description: Gain 3 1 STAR Rare Pokémon. The first time you get a 3 STAR Uncommon, Rare, Epic or Ultra Pokémon, gain a STAR_PIECE.

CHARGING_UP.name: Charging Up
CHARGING_UP.description: Gain a Mareep and a CELL_BATTERY. For every 12 player damage you deal, gain another CELL_BATTERY.

LONE_WOLF.name: Lone Wolf
LONE_WOLF.description: When only one allied Pokémon remains, it gains SHIELD equal to 50% of its base max HP and 80 SPEED for 5 seconds.

PARTING_GIFT.name: Parting Gift
PARTING_GIFT.description: When an allied Pokémon holding 3 items is KO'd, it transfers one of its items to a random ally within 2 tiles, which also gains 50 SHIELD.

REVEILLE.name: Reveille
REVEILLE.description: After 12 seconds of combat, the Pokémon on your 3 rightmost bench slots join the fight. All allied Pokémon are restored to max PP.

REQUIEM.name: Requiem
REQUIEM.description: When an allied Pokémon is KO'd, allies within 2 tiles gain SHIELD equal to 15% of their max HP.

CRITICAL_RUSH_I.name: Critical Rush I
CRITICAL_RUSH_I.description: The first time a Pokémon lands a critical hit, it gains 30 SPEED for 8 seconds.

CRITICAL_RUSH_II.name: Critical Rush II
CRITICAL_RUSH_II.description: The first time a Pokémon lands a critical hit, it gains 50 SPEED for 12 seconds. Each further critical hit during that time grants 5 SPEED for the rest of combat.

CRITICAL_PATH_I.name: Critical Path I
CRITICAL_PATH_I.description: At the start of combat, your STRONGEST Pokémon joins the Critical Path: its ability can critically strike. Each time a Pokémon on the Path casts, the next strongest ally joins. (Abilities that already critically strike gain 50% CRIT_POWER instead.)

CRITICAL_PATH_II.name: Critical Path II
CRITICAL_PATH_II.description: At the start of combat, your STRONGEST Pokémon joins the Critical Path: its ability can critically strike and it gains 20% CRIT_CHANCE. Each time a Pokémon on the Path casts, the next strongest ally joins. (Abilities that already critically strike gain 50% CRIT_POWER instead.)

PULSE_SHIELD_I.name: Pulse Shield I
PULSE_SHIELD_I.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain SHIELD equal to 70% of their SPEED.

PULSE_SHIELD_II.name: Pulse Shield II
PULSE_SHIELD_II.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 20 SPEED, then gain SHIELD equal to 70% of their SPEED.

MINIMALIST_I.name: Minimalist I
MINIMALIST_I.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 8% of their max PP as starting PP for each empty item slot.

MINIMALIST_II.name: Minimalist II
MINIMALIST_II.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 12% of their max PP as starting PP for each empty item slot. Pokémon holding no item also gain 40 AP.

LASTING_EFFECTS.name: Lasting Effects
LASTING_EFFECTS.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 10 LUCK. Negative statuses they inflict last 40% longer.

RIPPLING_EFFECTS.name: Rippling Effects
RIPPLING_EFFECTS.description: When an enemy is KO'd, every negative status it carries spreads to ADJACENT enemies, keeping its remaining duration. (CURSE does not spread)

EXPLOIT.name: Exploit
EXPLOIT.description: Allied Pokémon deal 20% more damage to enemies affected by a negative status. (Attacks and abilities)

GUARD_FORMATION.name: Guard Formation
GUARD_FORMATION.description: At the start of combat, the ally with the highest DEF in the front row grants allies ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW 50% of its DEF. The ally with the highest SPE_DEF in the middle row does the same with its SPE_DEF.

BRAVE_FORMATION.name: Brave Formation
BRAVE_FORMATION.description: At the start of combat, Pokémon gain 10% CRIT_CHANCE for each empty ADJACENT tile.

TOUGH_FORMATION.name: Tough Formation
TOUGH_FORMATION.description: At the start of combat, Pokémon gain 2 DEF and 2 SPE_DEF for each ADJACENT ally.

BURNING_SHARDS.name: Burning Shards
BURNING_SHARDS.description: Gain a Scorbunny and a FIRE_SHARD. For every 12 player damage you deal, gain another FIRE_SHARD.

POTION.name: Potion
POTION.description: Heal 15 player HP. In Double Up, your partner is healed as well.

TRANSFORM.name: Transform
TRANSFORM.description: Gain a Ditto. On stage 20, gain another.

TAXES.name: Taxes
TAXES.description: Gain 7 GOLD. All other players lose 1 GOLD.

ROCKY_BEGINNINGS.name: Rocky Beginnings

LEGENDARY_GAMBIT.description: On stage 20, gain a random Legendary matching your highest synergy.

DEEP_INVESTMENTS.name: Deep Investments
DEEP_INVESTMENTS.description: Lose all your GOLD. At the start of stage 16, regain all the lost GOLD plus 30 more.

CINCCINOS_GIFTS_III.name: Cinccino's Gifts III
CINCCINOS_GIFTS_III.description: Gain a SILK_SCARF and 2 random items crafted from a SILK_SCARF.

WILD_SUBSCRIPTION.name: Wild Subscription
WILD_SUBSCRIPTION.description: You are guaranteed to see at least 1 WILD Pokémon in your first shop each round.

CHOSEN_ONES.name: Chosen Ones
CHOSEN_ONES.description: When you pick an additional Pokémon, it immediately evolves with boosted stats.

ADDITIONAL_RETHINK_I.name: Additional Rethink I
ADDITIONAL_RETHINK_I.description: Gain 4 GOLD. You can reroll your additional pick options once. It rerolls all 3 Pokémon and items.

SAFARI_ENCOUNTER.name: Safari Encounter
SAFARI_ENCOUNTER.description: Gain a BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET and a random additional Pokémon matching your highest synergy, chosen from those not yet in the additional pool.

GYARODOS_TRES_QUATRO.name: Gyarodos, Tres, Quatro
GYARODOS_TRES_QUATRO.description: When WATER is active, you are guaranteed to fish a Magikarp, regardless of which rod you have.

FORECAST.name: Forecast
FORECAST.description: Your Pokémon synergies each count double towards weather.

WEATHER_INSTITUTE.name: Weather Institute
WEATHER_INSTITUTE.description: At combat start, if the weather is RAIN, ZENITH, DROUGHT or SNOW, summon a Castform matching the weather, holding an AQUA_EGG. Gain a Snover, Larvesta or Barboach.

BEEKEEPING.name: Beekeeping
BEEKEEPING.description: When your Unique casts its ability, spawn a Combee.

ARCANE_METALS.name: Arcane Metals
ARCANE_METALS.description: STEEL synergy converts ability damage into TRUE. Gain a Magnemite.

CURSE_OF_TWO.name: Curse of Two
CURSE_OF_TWO.description: Each of your GHOST curses affects 2 enemies at once.

VITAMINS.name: Vitamins
VITAMINS.description: At the start of the fight, your team gains 2 ATK, 10 AP and 10 SPEED.

DRAGON_FANG.name: Dragon Orb
DRAGON_FANG.description: Allies gain 2 AP per STAR of the units on your board.

QUIET_STRENGTH.name: Quiet Strength
QUIET_STRENGTH.description: The STRONGEST ally gains HP equal to your missing player HP at the start of combat. When under 25 player HP, this effect is doubled.

MISFORTUNE.name: Breaking Bones
MISFORTUNE.description: The STRONGEST enemy loses % max HP equal to your missing player HP at the start of combat.

SYNCHRONISED_SPEED_I.name: Synchronised Speed I
SYNCHRONISED_SPEED_I.description: The first time the ally with the highest base SPEED gets a KO, all other allies raise their base SPEED to match it.

SYNCHRONISED_SPEED_II.name: Synchronised Speed II
SYNCHRONISED_SPEED_II.description: The first time the ally with the highest SPEED gets a KO, all other allies raise their SPEED to match its current SPEED.

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_I.name: Potential Energy I
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_I.description: Allies gain 20 SHIELD and 10 SPEED for every STAR they are short of their final form.

POTENTIAL_ENERGY_II.name: Potential Energy II
POTENTIAL_ENERGY_II.description: Allies gain 30 SHIELD and 20 SPEED for every STAR they are short of their final form.

RIVALRY.name: Rivalry
RIVALRY.description: When your STRONGEST Pokémon gets a KO, it gains 1 permanent ATK if on your side of the board, or 4 permanent HP if on the enemy side of the board.

SHINY_SAFEGUARD.name: Shiny Safeguard
SHINY_SAFEGUARD.description: Allies that start combat in the front row gain PROTECT for 1.5 seconds the first time they drop below 50% HP.

CONTEMPT.name: Contempt
CONTEMPT.description: Allies deal 50% more damage to enemies with less STAR levels than them.

BABY_OPENER.name: Baby Opener
BABY_OPENER.description: Gain 3 random different BABY Pokémon costing 2 or less. Each time you obtain an egg, gain 2 player HP.

SELECTIVE_GENETICS.name: Selective Genetics
SELECTIVE_GENETICS.description: When a Golden Egg hatches, it opens up a choice of 3 shiny items to obtain instead of its usual reward. Gain 3 random BABY Pokémon costing 4 or less that you don't currently have, with a 5% chance for one of them to be a Golden Egg.

REPLICATOR.name: Replicator
REPLICATOR.description: Gain a DUBIOUS_DISC_BLESSING_ITEM. This item can be consumed to make a copy of any tool you have, which remains in your inventory regardless of your ARTIFICIAL level. Gain a Klink.

FIND_A_LOST_WAND.name: Find a Lost Wand
FIND_A_LOST_WAND.description: When FAIRY is active and the first wand has been chosen, gain the wand that was not offered to you in your FAIRY 2 options. Gain a Hatenna.

FAST_FOOD_DELIVERY.name: Fast Food Delivery
FAST_FOOD_DELIVERY.description: All GOURMET dishes are cooked to your inventory, and can be distributed among your Pokémon how you like, but turn into LEFTOVERS after 3 rounds. Gain a Nacli.

CHEFS_GREED.name: Chef's Greed
CHEFS_GREED.description: Your chefs cook an extra portion of their dish for themselves. Pokémon holding a CHEF_HAT can eat 2 dishes, or 3 if holding a BIG_EATER_BELT. Gain a Nacli.

BERRY_BREAKFAST.name: Berry Breakfast
BERRY_BREAKFAST.description: Berries can be given to Pokémon with 3 items as dishes. They are consumed at the start of the fight, with their healing converted into SHIELD. Gain 3 Berries and a Smoliv.

GEM_RUSH.name: Gem Rush
GEM_RUSH.description: Each time you fully dig out a row with GROUND, dig up an additional gem from the ground loot pool.

DIGGING_EQUIPMENT.name: Digging Equipment
DIGGING_EQUIPMENT.description: GROUND Pokémon on fully dug holes will instead dig a random ADJACENT tile, prioritising holes closer to completion. Gain a Nidoran♂.

CRYSTAL_MUTATION.name: Crystal Mutation
CRYSTAL_MUTATION.description: Immediately awaken your ROCK Unique with a random crystallisation.

CRYSTAL_CLUSTERS.name: Crystal Clusters
CRYSTAL_CLUSTERS.description: You can crystallise 2 Pokémon at once. The first time you activate ROCK 8, gain 2 random weather rocks, if you have space for them. Gain a Snorunt.

BERSERKER_HORDES.name: Berserker Hordes
BERSERKER_HORDES.description: WILD Pokémon cost 1 GOLD less for each WILD Pokémon at 3 STAR or more on your board, minimum 0. Every 10 shops, your shop will contain only WILD Pokémon.

GARDENING.name: Gardening
GARDENING.description: When you lose a PvP round, add 3/4/5/6 to your Mulch count when FLORA 3/4/5/6 is active. Gain a Gossifleur.

DOUBLE_WINDFALL.name: Double Windfall
DOUBLE_WINDFALL.description: When your FLORA synergy summons a member of the Hoppip line, it summons 2 instead. Gain a Flabébé.

AMAZING_GARDENING.name: Amazing Gardening
AMAZING_GARDENING.description: Gain an AMAZE_MULCH, plus another for each fully evolved flower, and another whenever a flower becomes fully evolved. Gain a Gossifleur.

FLYTRAP.name: Flytrap
FLYTRAP.description: The Bellsprout summoned by FLORA starts combat with a COVERT_CLOAK, and its ability affects all Pokémon within attack range. Gain a Gossifleur.

MEGA_SOL.name: Mega Sol
MEGA_SOL.description: The Chikorita summoned by FLORA starts combat with a SOOTHE_BELL. Allies within 2 spaces of it benefit from the effects of ZENITH even if the weather is not active. Gain a Gossifleur.

SPORE_CLOUDS.name: Spore Clouds
SPORE_CLOUDS.description: The Oddish summoned by FLORA starts combat with a KINGS_ROCK. Every 3 seconds, it releases a spore cloud that randomly POISON, PARALYSIS, BURN or SLEEP ADJACENT enemies for 3 seconds. Gain a Flabébé.

BLOSSOM_FESTIVAL.name: Blossom Festival
BLOSSOM_FESTIVAL.description: The Mulch gained from KO'd FLORA allies is doubled until you get Bellossom. Your STRONGEST Bellossom gains GRASS synergy, its ability affects all enemies within attack range, and it gains 1 RANGE every 3 casts.

NOT_THE_BEES.name: Not the Bees!
NOT_THE_BEES.description: At combat start, spawn a Combee on a random tile for each STAR level of your flower pots, up to 16.

ECHO_CHAMBER.name: Echo Chamber
ECHO_CHAMBER.description: When a SOUND Pokémon casts, your STRONGEST SOUND Pokémon gains 2 PP. When your STRONGEST SOUND Pokémon casts, all allies gain 4 PP. Gain an Igglybuff.

LANGUAGE_BARRIER.name: Language Barrier
LANGUAGE_BARRIER.description: When your Unown casts, allies gain 30 SHIELD, scaling with AP. Gain 2 random Unown.

MOVE_TUTOR.name: Move Tutor
MOVE_TUTOR.description: Pokémon with a TM ability have their max PP set to 80.

ZAP.name: Zap!
ZAP.description: ELECTRIC triple attacks chain to a random ADJACENT enemy, dealing 50% of the initial damage and applying ON_HIT effects. Gain a Grubbin.

SEEING_TRIPLE.name: Seeing Triple
SEEING_TRIPLE.description: Your STRONGEST BUG Pokémon is cloned one extra time at the start of combat, for three copies in total. Gain a Grubbin.

SACRIFICE.name: Sacrifice
SACRIFICE.description: At combat start, if MONSTER 2 is active, your STRONGEST MONSTER Pokémon KOs the weakest ADJACENT ally and is ENRAGED for 2 seconds. Gain a Lairon.

DRAGON_KING.name: Dragon King
DRAGON_KING.description: When a DRAGON ally is KO'd, your STRONGEST DRAGON Pokémon gains 5 SHIELD, 1 SPEED and 1 AP for each of the fallen ally's STAR. Gain a Charmander.

ASCENSION.name: Ascension
ASCENSION.description: The Pokémon in your LIGHT spot starts combat in stasis: it does not move or attack until its PP bar is full, and cannot be SILENCE or lose PP until then. When it breaks free, it triples all the stat buffs from LIGHT. Gain a Cherrim.

SHARE_THE_SPOTLIGHT.name: Share the Spotlight
SHARE_THE_SPOTLIGHT.description: The Pokémon in your LIGHT spot shares 50% of its ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF with ADJACENT allies.

SLIPSTREAM.name: Slipstream
SLIPSTREAM.description: When a FLYING Pokémon flies away, it gains 5 SPEED and grants 5 SPEED to allies it passes through. Gain a Quaxly.

BIG_PECKS.name: Big Pecks
BIG_PECKS.description: The first time you send a FLYING Pokémon away with a LETTER, it is guaranteed to come back with a SHARP_BEAK regardless of rarity. Gain a Quaxly.

SHAPELESS_SYNERGIES.name: Shapeless Synergies
SHAPELESS_SYNERGIES.description: Allies with at least 3 of their synergies active, including those granted by held items, gain 50% more SPEED and HP from the AMORPHOUS synergy, rounded up. Gain a Tynamo.

ABNORMALITY.name: Abnormality
ABNORMALITY.description: NORMAL Pokémon now gain SHIELD for each empty ADJACENT space instead of giving it to ADJACENT allies. Gain an Igglybuff.

WRAPPED_UP.name: Wrapped Up
WRAPPED_UP.description: NORMAL Pokémon holding a scarf item convert the SHIELD gained from NORMAL into max HP. Gain an Igglybuff.

BRACE_FOR_IMPACT.name: Brace for Impact
BRACE_FOR_IMPACT.description: FIGHTING Pokémon cannot take more than 40% of their maximum HP in a single instance of PHYSICAL or SPECIAL damage. Gain a Machop.

FROST_BARRIER.name: Frost Barrier
FROST_BARRIER.description: ICE Pokémon above 50% HP gain 15 DEF. ICE Pokémon below 50% HP gain 15 SPEED. Gain a Snorunt.

SECOND_WIND.name: Second Wind
SECOND_WIND.description: When a FIELD Pokémon revives with RESURRECTION, this counts as a KO for the synergy buffs. At the start of combat and every 10 seconds, the weakest FIELD Pokémon gains RESURRECTION. Gain a Litten.

FIRST_WIND.name: First Wind
FIRST_WIND.description: 10 seconds into combat, allies heal 40% of their max HP.

RESURGENCE.name: Resurgence
RESURGENCE.description: When your FOSSIL Pokémon revive, they gain 25 SPEED. Legendary FOSSIL Pokémon gain 35 instead. Gain a Piloswine.

POLLUTED_SEA.name: Polluted Sea
POLLUTED_SEA.description: Enemy Pokémon that take damage from a tidal wave or flood wave are POISON for 3 seconds.

TIDAL_SURGE.name: Tidal Surge
TIDAL_SURGE.description: When the TIDAL_WAVE hits, ranged AQUATIC Pokémon holding 2 items cast Hydro Pump, and melee AQUATIC Pokémon holding 2 items cast Dive.

ATLANTEAN_MAGIC.name: Atlantean Magic
ATLANTEAN_MAGIC.description: When a WATER Pokémon casts its ability, it gains 1 permanent AP per STAR level.

STAR_CROSSED_SEAS.name: Star-Crossed Seas
STAR_CROSSED_SEAS.description: Move to an AMORPHOUS region if not currently in one. You can find both kinds of Shellos in AMORPHOUS regions. Fielding them both at once grants each one 50 HP and 25 AP.

HEX_MANIAC.name: Hex Maniac
HEX_MANIAC.description: At GHOST 2/4/6/8, curses also inflict ARMOR_BREAK,FATIGUE,PARALYSIS,SILENCE. Gain a Snorunt.

ABSOLUTE_DARKNESS.name: Absolute Darkness
ABSOLUTE_DARKNESS.description: DARK Pokémon have a 5% chance to inflict their target with BLINDED for 3 seconds ON_ATTACK. Allies convert all their damage to TRUE against BLINDED enemies when they crit. Gain an Impidimp.

TOXIC_BURST.name: Toxic Burst
TOXIC_BURST.description: When a POISONNED enemy is KO'd, they explode, spreading their poison stacks to ADJACENT enemies. Gain a Spinarak.

EXHAUSTING_FLAME.name: Exhausting Flame
EXHAUSTING_FLAME.description: Your FIRE Pokémon take 20% less damage from BURN enemies, and gain 5 LUCK per STAR. Gain a Litten.

ETERNAL_RAGE.name: Eternal Rage
ETERNAL_RAGE.description: When a WILD Pokémon is KO'd, the STRONGEST ADJACENT WILD ally is RAGE for 1/2/3 seconds, based on the KO'd ally's STAR level. Gain an Aipom.

MISFITS.name: Misfits
MISFITS.description: Allies with no active synergies gain 40 HP, 40 AP, 4 ATK, 4 DEF and 4 SPE_DEF per STAR.

OLIVE_GARDEN.name: Olive Garden
OLIVE_GARDEN.description: Gain a Smoliv. Your STRONGEST Smoliv starts combat with GRASS_FIELD, or with PSYCHIC_FIELD, FAIRY_FIELD or ELECTRIC_FIELD instead if you give it that synergy with a stone, picked at random if it has several.

ORBITAL_STRIKE.name: Orbital Strike
ORBITAL_STRIKE.description: Gain a Dottler. At the start of combat, your STRONGEST Blipbug gets +2 RANGE. Your other STRONGEST Pokémon with 1 RANGE starts the combat with PSYCHIC_FIELD.

ROOSTING_FLOCK.name: Roosting Flock
ROOSTING_FLOCK.description: Gain a Tranquill and move to a random Pidove region if not in one. When your STRONGEST Pidove casts its ability, ADJACENT FLYING allies cast Roost as well.

MONSTER_KING.name: King of the Monsters
MONSTER_KING.description: Every 8 seconds, your ally with the most MONSTER stacks fires Hyper Beam (at its own STAR level), towards the largest group of enemies.

ADOPTION.name: Adoption Agency
ADOPTION.description: At the start of each round, adopt a BABY Pokémon you have not received yet this game, cheapest first. Once every BABY has been adopted, you receive a Happiny every round instead.

RAINBOW_DROPLET.name: Rainbow Droplet
RAINBOW_DROPLET.description: The first time you reach AMORPHOUS 7 with 8 synergies active, every synergy except AMORPHOUS permanently gains +1.

ARCHEOLOGY.name: Archeological Site
ARCHEOLOGY.description: FOSSIL Pokémon dig every round even without GROUND active. Fully digging a hole unearths a random FOSSIL Pokémon, with a 10% chance it is 2 star. Fully digging a row unearths a FOSSIL unique, and the whole board a FOSSIL legendary.

LIMIT_BREAKER.name: Limit Breaker
LIMIT_BREAKER.description:
Abilities of your fully evolved DRAGON Pokémon are one STAR level stronger.
Every time you get a 3 STAR DRAGON, you gain free rerolls:
- Common: 4
- Uncommon: 8
- Rare: 12
- Epic: 16
- Ultra: 20
Other Rarities are excluded.

CHAMPIONS_MASK.name: Champion's Mask
CHAMPIONS_MASK.description: Gain a CHAMPIONS_MASK. At the start of combat, allies with a CHAMPIONS_MASK gain 50 SHIELD per FIGHTING tier.

AUTO_CRAFTING.name: Auto-Crafting
AUTO_CRAFTING.description: At the start of combat, each ARTIFICIAL Pokémon holding a component turns it into a random craftable item made with that component for that combat. Synergy stones and WONDER_BOX are excluded. Gain 2 random components.

CENTER_STAGE.name: Center Stage
CENTER_STAGE.description: At the start of combat, your STRONGEST SOUND ally gains a pink spotlight. Other ADJACENT SOUND Pokémon emit twice as many sound cries. (The Grookey family has stage fright and refuses the spotlight.)

HIEROGLYPHS.name: Hieroglyphs
HIEROGLYPHS.description: Unown have 50% less max PP. When an Unown casts its ability, summon a random Unown in the safest corner of the board. Unown ! and Unown Q cannot trigger this summon or be summoned.

BURNING_FORCE.name: Burning Force
BURNING_FORCE.description: At the start of combat, Pokémon with no ADJACENT allies are BURN for the rest of the fight and gain 50% of their base ATK.

SPIKY_GUARD.name: Spiky Guard
SPIKY_GUARD.description: At the start of combat, Pokémon with no ADJACENT allies retaliate against melee attackers, dealing 10% of their current DEF and SPE_DEF as SPECIAL.

DRILL_I.name: Drill I
DRILL_I.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 50% of its current ATK as additional TRUE for 8 seconds.

DRILL_II.name: Drill II
DRILL_II.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 50% of its current ATK as additional TRUE for 12 seconds. This also hits an enemy directly behind the target.

SHATTER_I.name: Shatter I
SHATTER_I.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 50% of its current DEF and SPE_DEF as additional PHYSICAL for 8 seconds.

SHATTER_II.name: Shatter II
SHATTER_II.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 50% of its current DEF and SPE_DEF as additional PHYSICAL for 12 seconds. This also hits an enemy directly behind the target.

SURGE_I.name: Surge I
SURGE_I.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 25% of its current SPEED as additional SPECIAL for 8 seconds.

SURGE_II.name: Surge II
SURGE_II.description: The first time a Pokémon falls below 60% max HP, its basic attacks deal 25% of its current SPEED as additional SPECIAL for 12 seconds. This also hits an enemy directly behind the target.

GEAR_SHIELD_I.name: Gear Shield I
GEAR_SHIELD_I.description: At the start of combat, melee Pokémon gain 20 SHIELD per held item.

GEAR_SHIELD_II.name: Gear Shield II
GEAR_SHIELD_II.description: At the start of combat, melee Pokémon gain 30 SHIELD per held item. When this SHIELD is depleted, ADJACENT enemies suffer ARMOR_BREAK for 3 seconds.

MAGIC_SHIELD_I.name: Magic Shield I
MAGIC_SHIELD_I.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain SHIELD equal to their AP.

MAGIC_SHIELD_II.name: Magic Shield II
MAGIC_SHIELD_II.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 30 AP, then gain SHIELD equal to their AP.

BRUTE_SHIELD_I.name: Brute Shield I
BRUTE_SHIELD_I.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain SHIELD equal to 300% of their ATK.

BRUTE_SHIELD_II.name: Brute Shield II
BRUTE_SHIELD_II.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 3 ATK, then gain SHIELD equal to 300% of their ATK.

STAR_GUARD.name: Star Guard
STAR_GUARD.description: At the start of combat, your Pokémon gain 1 DEF and SPE_DEF for each STAR on your board.

MACHINE_RESIDUE.name: Machine Residue
MACHINE_RESIDUE.description: ARTIFICIAL Pokémon holding a tool place SPIKES beneath their target ON_ATTACK. When an allied ARTIFICIAL Pokémon walks over SPIKES, it clears them and gains 20 SHIELD instead of being affected. Gain a Klang.

CALCULATED_OFFENCE.name: Calculated Offence
CALCULATED_OFFENCE.description: All non-TRUE dealt by your Pokémon becomes PHYSICAL when the target's DEF is lower, or SPECIAL when its SPE_DEF is lower. If both are equal, the damage type does not change.

ROBIN_GEMS.name: Robin Gems
ROBIN_GEMS.description: The first time you defeat each opponent, gain a gem matching their highest synergy. If multiple synergies are tied, one is chosen at random.

FURIOUS_FABRIC.name: Furious Fabric
FURIOUS_FABRIC.description:
Every item crafted from a SILK_SCARF also gives a synergy to the Pokémon holding it:
- BIG_EATER_BELT: GOURMET
- EFFICIENT_BANDANNA: SOUND
- COVER_BAND: GROUND
- TWIST_BAND: PSYCHIC
- EXPLOSIVE_BAND: WILD
- MACH_RIBBON: FIELD
- BLACK_BELT: FIGHTING
- LUCKY_RIBBON: FAIRY
- TIGHT_BELT: BUG
- FRIEND_BOW: GRASS
- NULLIFY_BANDANNA: FLYING

GEM_HARVEST.name: Gem Harvest
GEM_HARVEST.description: Crystallisation takes 1 round less to complete. When a crystallisation finishes, you gain a gem matching the crystal's type. Each gem in your inventory gives your Pokémon 10 AP if they share its synergy.

MAGNETOSPHERE.name: Magnetosphere
MAGNETOSPHERE.description: Your STEEL Pokémon create a magnetic field with 1 RANGE per tier of STEEL, switching between attraction and repulsion every 8 seconds. Attraction pulls enemies in RANGE into contact and inflicts PARALYSIS for 8 seconds. Repulsion pushes them away, inflicts LOCKED for 2 seconds, and grants your STEEL Pokémon that much RANGE while it lasts.

MYSTOGAN.name: Mystogan
MYSTOGAN.description: At each FAIRY tier, your FAIRY Pokémon also gain the effect of the wand that was left out of the offer, but not its extra SPECIAL. Wand effects are [5,LK]% more likely to happen.

FESTIVE_PICNIC.name: Festive Picnic
FESTIVE_PICNIC.description: At the start of every preparation phase, each of your Pokémon without a dish receives a random one. A dish cooked by your own Pokémon replaces it, and the Pokémon permanently gains 5 max HP.

ICY_REFLECTION.name: Icy Reflection
ICY_REFLECTION.description: Your ICE Pokémon store all the damage their SPE_DEF blocks. Every time the stored amount reaches 25% of their max HP, they cast back the last ability that damaged them, at their own STAR level.

BULL_LEAPING.name: Bull Leaping
BULL_LEAPING.description: When your FIELD Pokémon cast their ability, they use a second one at 1 STAR right after: melee ones leap with Aqua Jet, Flame Charge or Volt Switch if they are WATER, FIRE or ELECTRIC, or Psyshield Bash otherwise. Ranged ones, and any that would repeat their own ability, use Happy Hour instead.

OVERLOAD.name: Overload
OVERLOAD.description: At the start of combat and every 8 seconds, the STRONGEST of your ELECTRIC Pokémon (not yet empowered) is empowered by Volt Surge: it gains ELECTRIC_FIELD, 20 SPEED and bonus HP, and every 3rd attack chains lightning to 4 enemies. Its own ability is unchanged.

FOGBOUND_LAKE.name: Fogbound Lake
FOGBOUND_LAKE.description: When a BUG Pokémon would clone, it spawns a Volbeat or an Illumise instead. BUG 8 adds +1 to LIGHT, and every Volbeat and Illumise gains the effects of your active LIGHT spot.

TIDAL_GUARDIAN.name: Tidal Guardian
TIDAL_GUARDIAN.description: AQUATIC 8 now summons Lugia instead of Surfing Pikachu. On every TIDAL_WAVE, Lugia casts Whirlpool on 3 different random enemies.

GRUDGE.name: Grudge
GRUDGE.description: When one of your GHOST Pokémon is KO'd, it has a [30,LK]% chance to CURSE the enemy that defeated it (8 seconds). If you win the fight and your opponent has a free bench slot, they receive a locked Substitute that costs them 4 GOLD to sell. Each locked Substitute on their bench reduces the duration of any CURSE you inflict by 1 second, whatever its source.

SOUL_BLAZE.name: Soul Blaze
SOUL_BLAZE.description: A FIRE_SHARD ignites at any FIRE tier, and your Pokémon never wait between two ignitions.

FERTILE_SOIL.name: Fertile Soil
FERTILE_SOIL.description: GROUND Pokémon gain 5 permanent max HP each time they dig. Pokémon starting a fight on a fully dug hole gain 10% max HP. A non-GROUND Pokémon that spends 5 rounds on a fully dug hole absorbs the soil, becoming GROUND and gaining the SMOOTH_ROCK awakening.

DEEP_WOUNDS.name: Deep Wounds
DEEP_WOUNDS.description: Critical hits inflict ARMOR_BREAK for 5 seconds. If already ARMOR_BREAK, [30,LK]% chance to remove 2 DEF and SPE_DEF permanently.

FAST_DELIVERY.name: Fast Delivery
FAST_DELIVERY.description: FLYING Pokémon always deliver the LETTER in 1 turn. At the start of combat, your FLYING Pokémon gain 5 LUCK for each Seed you have collected.

MOLECULAR_CORROSION.name: Molecular Corrosion
MOLECULAR_CORROSION.description: Enemy Pokémon under POISONNED take 30% more damage from all sources, and your POISONNED can no longer be blocked by RUNE_PROTECT.

UNISON.name: Unison
UNISON.description:
Your TMs are no longer consumed when taught to a HUMAN Pokémon.
Damage dealt by your HUMAN Pokémon builds their bond (max 1000). When this bond reaches maximum power or is broken by the first HUMAN Pokémon being KO'd, your surviving Pokémon retaliate together, dividing the accumulated damage between all enemies as SPECIAL. This counts as a HUMAN attack.

BERRY_GROWTH.name: Berry Growth
BERRY_GROWTH.description: Every Berry eaten also grants the Pokémon +10 permanent max HP, or +15 for a golden Berry. At GRASS 7, your berry trees turn golden. If taken on stage 12, gain 2 golden Berries.

WATER_FOUNTAIN.name: Water Fountain
WATER_FOUNTAIN.description:
Travel to a Pond region, and from now on you can only travel to Pond regions.
Two Ponds appear on your board, defensive in front and offensive in the back, moving every 4 stages. A Pokémon starting the fight in a Pond gains its effect, doubled at WATER 6 and quadrupled at WATER 9.
Your Pokémon can no longer dig. Gain a Squirtle.

WOBBUFFETS_GOLD_PRIZE.name: Gold Kit
WOBBUFFETS_GOLD_PRIZE.description: Gain a random item component and 2 RECYCLE_TICKET. Each time you use a RECYCLE_TICKET, gain a random item component.

HARD_COMMIT.name: Hard Commit
HARD_COMMIT.description: Gain a random gem. At stage 10 and stage 20, gain another copy of that same gem.

REGIONAL_TREASURES.name: Regional Treasures
REGIONAL_TREASURES.description: Gain a random gem matching one of your region's synergies, now and each time you change region.

REGIONAL_TREASURES_II.name: Regional Treasures II
REGIONAL_TREASURES_II.description: Gain a gem for each of your region's synergies, now and each time you change region.

SYNARCH.name: Synarch
SYNARCH.description: Gain a gem matching each base synergy of your Unique Pokémon. If that is less than 3 gems, random gems make up the difference.

FLEXIBILITY.name: Flexibility
FLEXIBILITY.description: Gain 3 FOSSIL_STONE and 3 random item components. Your team gains 12 HP per distinct synergy item equipped across your Pokémon.

RAINBOW_HOUR.name: Rainbow Hour
RAINBOW_HOUR.description: Gain 2 FOSSIL_STONE. Each time you craft a synergy stone, gain an Eevee. Each Eevee evolution contributes its synergies separately. The first time you field 7 different Eevee evolutions, gain 77 GOLD.

MANIFESTATION_AP.name: Manifestation: AP
MANIFESTATION_AP.description: Gain a random Drizzile, Duosion, Luxio or Thwackey holding a SOUL_DEW. Until stage 20 the unit is locked and sells for 0 GOLD.

MANIFESTATION_AD.name: Manifestation: ATK
MANIFESTATION_AD.description: Gain a random Arctibax, Bisharp, Fletchinder or Porygon2 holding a RED_ORB. Until stage 20 the unit is locked and sells for 0 GOLD.

MANIFESTATION_DEF.name: Manifestation: DEF
MANIFESTATION_DEF.description: Gain a random Chansey, Dusclops, Gurdurr or Swadloon holding a ROCKY_HELMET. Until stage 20 the unit is locked and sells for 0 GOLD.

MIX_AND_MATCH_I.name: Mix and Match I
MIX_AND_MATCH_I.description: Gain 3 random Unique Pokémon. Your Unique Pokémon sell for 0 GOLD, and you can field at most 2 of them at a time.

MIX_AND_MATCH_II.name: Mix and Match II
MIX_AND_MATCH_II.description: Gain 4 random Unique Pokémon. Your Unique Pokémon sell for 0 GOLD, and you can field at most 3 of them at a time.

WAITING_GAME.name: Waiting Game
WAITING_GAME.description: After each round, gain a free reroll, or 2 if you did not reroll during that round.

PRISMATIC_REROLL.name: Prismatic Reroll
PRISMATIC_REROLL.description: Each reroll has a 25% chance to gain 2 free rerolls. Free rerolls can grant free rerolls in turn as well.

LUNCH_MONEY.name: Prize Money
LUNCH_MONEY.description: For every 8 player damage you deal, gain 2 GOLD and a free reroll.

CALCULATED_LOSS.name: Calculated Loss
CALCULATED_LOSS.description: When you lose, gain 2 GOLD and a free reroll.

A_NEW_FRIEND.name: A New Friend
A_NEW_FRIEND.description: Gain a random Rare Pokémon. Gain another copy whenever you level up.

BP_REWARDS.name: Battle Point Rewards
BP_REWARDS.description: Gain 2 random item components. Every 5 rounds after selecting this Wish, gain 1 more.

GREEDY_WISH.name: Greedy Wish
GREEDY_WISH.description: Your next Wish selection is one tier higher. If it is already Prismatic, gain 10 GOLD instead.

CALLED_SHOT.name: Called Shot
CALLED_SHOT.description: Set your win streak to 4 and gain 4 GOLD.

VAMPIRIC.name: Vampiric
VAMPIRIC.description: In combat, allied Pokémon heal for 20% of the damage they deal. Between rounds, you heal 1 player HP for every 10 player damage you deal, rounded up. Gain a Chimchar.

PROTECT_THE_WEAK.name: Protect the Weak
PROTECT_THE_WEAK.description: Epic, Ultra and Legendary Pokémon gain 20 HP and 7 SPEED for each Common and Uncommon Pokémon on your board.

STURDY.name: Sturdy
STURDY.description: The first time you would be eliminated this game, survive on 1 HP and grant allies 30 HP, 4 DEF and 4 SPE_DEF permanently.

ALL_FOR_ONE.name: All for One
ALL_FOR_ONE.description: Lose all of your non-Unique Pokémon. Gain a Substitute with 100% of their combined max HP.

RAINBOW_KEY.name: Rainbow Key
RAINBOW_KEY.description: Transform all of your non-Unique and non-Hatch Pokémon below Ultra rarity into random units one rarity higher, keeping their STAR level.

PLUSHIFY.name: Plushify
PLUSHIFY.description: Gain a POKE_DOLL. When an ally holding a POKE_DOLL is KO'd, spawn a Substitute with its max HP.

SUPPORTIVE_SOUL.name: Supportive Soul
SUPPORTIVE_SOUL.description: Gain a Substitute holding a random support item on the board. It does not count toward board size and cannot be sold or have its items changed. Every 8 rounds, it gains another support item until full.

LANCES_ACE.name: Lance's Ace
LANCES_ACE.description: After 3 rounds, gain a Dratini. Your STRONGEST Dratini has +2 RANGE, its Ability is replaced with Hyperbeam, and it permanently gains 1 AP whenever it scores a KO.

PANIC_BUTTON.name: Panic Button
PANIC_BUTTON.description: Gain an Unown-Q. Its max PP is set to 10, and the draw it casts now deals 4 player damage to your opponent.

TRASH_TO_TREASURE.name: Trash to Treasure
TRASH_TO_TREASURE.description: Gain a Trubbish, a Beldum and 1 to 3 TRASH. Each Beldum, Metang, or Metagross holding TRASH independently recycles it into a random Tool after 5/3/1 rounds at 1/2/3 STAR.

CHARGING_MY_BUG.name: Charging My Bug
CHARGING_MY_BUG.description: Gain a Charjabug. Your STRONGEST Grubbin gains 2 permanent ATK when starting combat in a fully dug hole on board.

NEUROFORCE.name: Neuroforce
NEUROFORCE.description: The ally with the highest AP attacks deal SPECIAL and scale with AP.

SINNOHS_COOLEST.name: Sinnoh's Coolest
SINNOHS_COOLEST.description: Gain a Staravia and move to a random Starly region if you are not currently in one. The first time you get a Staraptor, gain SAFETY_GOGGLES.

AXE_BLAST.name: Axe Blast
AXE_BLAST.description: Gain an Axew. It gains +1 RANGE and its Ability is replaced with Axe Blast.

SWEET_TREATS.name: Sweet Treats
SWEET_TREATS.description: Now and at the start of each round, randomly gain a CASTELIACONE or WHIPPED_DREAM in your inventory. After 1 round, an unconsumed treat turns into LEFTOVERS.

SNIFFER_DOG.name: Sniffer Dog
SNIFFER_DOG.description: Gain a Lillipup. While Lillipup is fielded and GROUND is active, benched GROUND allies dig holes. When the STRONGEST Lillipup casts its Ability, a random Pokémon on a fully dug bench hole enters battle through a fully dug board hole.

JESTER.name: Jester
JESTER.description: Gain a Sprigatito. When your STRONGEST Sprigatito casts its Ability, a Substitute with full PP appears nearby. It casts Metronome at 1 STAR, gaining 1 STAR for each additional 100% CRIT_POWER of the caster, up to 4 STAR.

TOXIC_RESONANCE.name: Toxic Resonance
TOXIC_RESONANCE.description: Gain a Tympole. Your STRONGEST Tympole resonates every 3 seconds. Each beat spreads 1 tile further than the last. Pokémon caught in the wave are POISONNED for 3 seconds, allies included. Poisoned allies gain 5 PP. The 4th beat covers the whole board and gives 30 PP instead. The cycle then restarts.

GRAND_IGNITION.name: Grand Ignition
GRAND_IGNITION.description: Gain a Fennekin. When your STRONGEST Fennekin casts its Ability, it throws a torch to a random corner of the board and reduces its own max PP by 10%. Once all four corners are lit, the battlefield ignites: every enemy permanently loses 10% of its max HP and suffers double BURN damage for the rest of the fight, which cannot be reduced or cleansed.

VALOR.name: Valor
VALOR.description: Gain a Pignite. At the start of combat, your STRONGEST Tepig gains 1 ATK and 10 SHIELD for each WILD STAR on your bench, and the same again for each ally KO'd during the fight.

COLONY.name: Colony
COLONY.description: Gain a Scatterbug. When your STRONGEST Vivillon KO's its target, a Spewpa joins your bench. It evolves after 2 rounds and sells for 0 GOLD. Only one Spewpa is attracted at a time, so it must evolve before the next arrives. Every Vivillon contributes its own synergies. The swarm has grown fond of you and refuses to be sent to your partner.

SAND_BUDDIES.name: Sand Buddies
SAND_BUDDIES.description: Gain a Sandile. When your STRONGEST Sandile fails to KO its target with its Ability, a Trapinch with full PP appears nearby, at the same STAR level.

YOU_FORGOT_SOMETHING.name: You Forgot Something!
YOU_FORGOT_SOMETHING.description: The first Pokémon you KO'd in your last PvE round joins your team after 8 seconds of PvP combat, holding the two items you didn't choose.

THINK_FAST.name: Pokemon APM
THINK_FAST.description: Gain infinite rerolls this turn. All shop rerolls cost no GOLD until the end of the preparation phase.

WISE_SPENDING.name: Efficient Economy
WISE_SPENDING.description: You cannot buy XP. Every reroll grants 2 XP.

BIRTHDAY_PRESENT.name: Friend Subscription
BIRTHDAY_PRESENT.description: Whenever you level up, gain a 2 STAR Pokemon and 1 GOLD. Its rarity is Common at level 4-5, Uncommon at 6, Rare at 7, Epic at 8, and Ultra at 9-10.

UP_IS_UP.name: Reinvigorate
UP_IS_UP.description: Whenever you buy XP, gain 1 GOLD and restore 1 player HP.

DROP_RATES.name: Drop Rates
DROP_RATES.description: KO's from your STRONGEST ally have a [40,LK]% chance to grant 1 free reroll.

MORE_EQUAL_THAN_OTHERS.name: More Equal than Others
MORE_EQUAL_THAN_OTHERS.description: Gain 10 GOLD and a random item component. Every other living player gains 5 GOLD.

CLIMBING_THE_LADDER.name: Climbing the Ladder
CLIMBING_THE_LADDER.description: Immediately reach level 4 if below it. Each level up costs 4 less XP, and you can now reach level 10.

QUEST_EVOLVE.name: Quest: Evolve
QUEST_EVOLVE.description: Gain MISSION_ORDER_PINK and a random 2 STAR common Pokémon.

QUEST_DESTROY.name: Quest: Destroy
QUEST_DESTROY.description: Gain MISSION_ORDER_RED and a random 2 STAR common Pokémon.

QUEST_LEVEL_UP.name: Quest: Level Up
QUEST_LEVEL_UP.description: Gain MISSION_ORDER_BLUE and a random 2 STAR common Pokémon.

QUEST_DIVERSIFY.name: Quest: Diversify
QUEST_DIVERSIFY.description: Gain MISSION_ORDER_GREEN and a random 2 STAR common Pokémon.

QUEST_PROSPER.name: Quest: Prosper
QUEST_PROSPER.description: Gain MISSION_ORDER_GOLD and a random 2 STAR common Pokémon.

QUEST_INDECISION.name: Quest: Indecision
QUEST_INDECISION.description: Gain 2 random gems. Entering a fight with a synergy at its highest tier counts it. After 3 different synergies, gain a GOLD_MASK. They do not have to be active at once.

QUEST_CRIT.name: Quest: Crit
QUEST_CRIT.description: Gain 2 BLACK_GLASSES. The first time an ally reaches 5 CRIT_POWER in a fight, gain a GOLD_BOTTLE_CAP.

QUEST_ABSORB.name: Quest: Absorb
QUEST_ABSORB.description: Gain a HEART_SCALE and a NEVER_MELT_ICE. The first time an ally blocks 1000 damage in a fight, gain an ABSORB_BULB.

QUEST_REVIVE.name: Quest: Revive
QUEST_REVIVE.description: Gain a MAX_REVIVE. After allies have been revived 16 times, gain a SACRED_ASH.

QUEST_PILLAGE.name: Quest: Pillage
QUEST_PILLAGE.description: Gain an AMULET_COIN. Its holder gains 1 CRIT_CHANCE for every 2 GOLD at the start of the fight. After it has made you 30 GOLD, gain a BOOSTER_ENERGY.

QUEST_EVOLVE_II.name: Quest: Evolve II
QUEST_EVOLVE_II.description: Gain an Eevee and 2 Rare 1 STAR Pokémon. After evolving Pokémon 12 times, gain a RARE_CANDY.

IMPENDING_DOOM.name: Impending Doom
IMPENDING_DOOM.description: After 10 seconds of combat, a shadow engulfs the battle, removing PROTECT, RUNE_PROTECT and RESURRECTION from all enemy Pokémon. For the remainder of combat, no enemy can receive these effects. Accelerate the shadow's countdown by 1 second when a CURSE enemy is KOed. Gain a Dartix.

SYNCHRONICITY.name: Synchronicity
SYNCHRONICITY.description: Obtain the SYNCHRO_MASHINE. At the start of combat, the holder copies the highest HP, ATK, AP, DEF and SPE_DEF of any allied Pokémon on the field.

STARTER_CHOICE.name: Starter Choice
STARTER_CHOICE.description: Choose between 3 common 1 STAR Pokémon. Gain a copy now and at the start of the next 8 rounds.

SINGULARITY_I.name: Singularity I
SINGULARITY_I.description: Choose from 3 components. Gain a copy now, on stage 10 and stage 20.

SINGULARITY_II.name: Singularity II
SINGULARITY_II.description: Choose from 3 components. Gain a copy now and on stages 10, 15, 20 and 25.

CURSE_OF_CORAL.name: Curse of Coral
CURSE_OF_CORAL.description: Now and after every PvP round, gain a Corsola. Your Cursola sell for 18 GOLD.

TEMPLE_OF_LANGUAGE.name: Temple of Language
TEMPLE_OF_LANGUAGE.description: Gain an Unown after every PvE fight. Unown do not count towards your board's total units.

TREASURE_TRAIL.name: Treasure Trail
TREASURE_TRAIL.description: Highlight a tile on your board that contains treasure. Whenever you dig up treasure, highlight another tile that contains treasure, if any. Your STRONGEST ally digs a hole after every fight, even without GROUND.

TRAINING_MONTAGE.name: Training Montage
TRAINING_MONTAGE.description: Gain a BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET. Any time a Pokémon comes back from the dojo, gain another BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET.

ALL_FOURS.name: All Fours
ALL_FOURS.description: Open a shop of all Epic Pokémon. The first one you buy is free. Gain a BRONZE_DOJO_TICKET.

BEING_OF_KNOWLEDGE.name: Being of Knowledge
BEING_OF_KNOWLEDGE.description: Upon reaching level 7, gain a Uxie with no ATK, DEF or SPE_DEF. You can now reach level 10.

HYPER_HYPER_ROLL.name: Hyper Hyper Roll
HYPER_HYPER_ROLL.description: The next common Pokémon you buy immediately evolves to 3 STAR.

BEAUTY_CONTEST.name: Beauty Contest
BEAUTY_CONTEST.description: When WATER is active, you are guaranteed to fish a Feebas after every PvE round, regardless of which rod you have. Multiple Milotic can each contribute their synergies to your total.

QUICK_CLAW.name: Quick Claw
QUICK_CLAW.description: You can move as soon as the carousel round starts. If taken on stage 12, gain a random component.

COLOUR_CHANGE.name: Colour Change
COLOUR_CHANGE.description: You cannot move on the stage 10 carousel, but your Unique pick options are guaranteed to include Kecleon.

AZURE_FLUTE.name: Azure Flute
AZURE_FLUTE.description: You cannot move on the stage 20 carousel, but your Legendary pick options are guaranteed to include Arceus.

ADDITIONAL_RETHINK_II.name: Additional Rethink II
ADDITIONAL_RETHINK_II.description: Gain 8 GOLD. You can reroll your additional pick options. Each pokemon and item can be individually rerolled.

FREE_COUPON.name: Gift Bag
FREE_COUPON.description: Take your item from carousel shops for free. If any player has this Wish, a shop encounter is guaranteed by stage 22.

SOUL_DRAIN.name: Soul Drain
SOUL_DRAIN.description: Gain a Litwick. Your STRONGEST Litwick's ability cast pulls a Soul Fragment from the target, healing allies it travels through for [20,SP] HP. Two Fragments are pulled if the ability KO's the target.

FLOWER_QUEEN.name: Flower Queen
FLOWER_QUEEN.description: Gain a METRONOME and a Floette. Your STRONGEST Flabebe reduces its max PP by 4 after each cast.

LEAF_TORNADO.name: Leaf Tornado
LEAF_TORNADO.description: Gain a Snivy. Your STRONGEST Snivy's attacks ricochet to up to 2 additional enemies, applying ON_HIT effects, the damage halving with each bounce.

MARIACHI_MAYHEM.name: Mariachi Mayhem
MARIACHI_MAYHEM.description: Gain a Lotad. When your STRONGEST Lotad casts its ability, all enemies within its RANGE suffer CONFUSION for 2 seconds.

ICEBREAKER.name: Icebreaker
ICEBREAKER.description: Gain a Piplup. Your STRONGEST Piplup's ability executes FREEZE enemies. On a KO, it grants double SHIELD and 20 LUCK.

RAMPAGE.name: Rampage
RAMPAGE.description: Gain a Deino. Your STRONGEST Deino's ability can critically strike. Each time it KO's an ADJACENT enemy, the ability and its SILENCE last 2 seconds longer. After 5 seconds of channeling, the damage doubles for the rest of the cast.

FROST_BURST.name: Frost Burst
FROST_BURST.description: Gain a Snover and move to a random Snover region if not in one. When your STRONGEST Snover's ability KO's an enemy, 50% of the damage is dealt to ADJACENT enemies, which can also execute at half the chance. This effect cannot chain.

AURORA_BOREALIS.name: Aurora Borealis
AURORA_BOREALIS.description: Gain an Amaura and add it to the pool. While you field an Amaura, your team takes 10% less PHYSICAL and SPECIAL damage, increased to 15% in SNOW or NIGHT, plus 1% per active synergy.

RADIANCE.name: Radiance
RADIANCE.description: Gain a Larvesta and add it to the pool. Your STRONGEST Larvesta gains the LIGHT synergy, and while LIGHT is active it starts combat with its own spotlight.

PACK_ATTACK.name: Pack Attack
PACK_ATTACK.description: Gain a Houndour and add it to the pool. Each Houndour summoned by your STRONGEST Houndour's ability has a 15% chance to be a Houndoom instead.

MORTAR_SHELLS.name: Mortar Shells
MORTAR_SHELLS.description: Gain a Magby. Your STRONGEST Magby gains +3 RANGE and +150% base ATK, but has 50% reduced base SPEED.

ICE_SPEAR.name: Ice Spear
ICE_SPEAR.description: Gain a Vanillite. Your STRONGEST Vanillite's missiles cannot miss, and refund 20 PP upon KO'ing an enemy.

FROST_GEAR.name: Frost Gear
FROST_GEAR.description: Gain a Shellder and add it to the pool. Your STRONGEST Shellder has +3 RANGE, its PP set to 70, and its Shell Smash ATK gain scales with AP.

SHUTTLE_BUS.name: Shuttle Bus
SHUTTLE_BUS.description: Gain a Skiddo and add it to the pool. Your STRONGEST Skiddo has its PP set to 110, but starts combat with full PP.

PLUNDER.name: Plunder
PLUNDER.description: Gain a Galarian Meowth, add it to the pool and move to a random STEEL region if not in one. Upon winning combat, gain double the GOLD your STRONGEST Galarian Meowth spent with its ability that combat.

EMERALD_ORB.name: Emerald Orb
EMERALD_ORB.description: Gain a GREEN_ORB. Your GREEN_ORB heals in a 2-tile radius.

SAPPHIRE_ORB.name: Sapphire Orb
SAPPHIRE_ORB.description: Gain a BLUE_ORB. Your BLUE_ORB chain lightning hits 1 additional enemy and applies ARMOR_BREAK for 3 seconds.

RUBY_ORB.name: Ruby Orb
RUBY_ORB.description: Gain a RED_ORB. Your RED_ORB converts 50% of attack damage to TRUE against BURN enemies, instead of 25%.

LUCKY_DICE_BLESSING.name: Lucky Ward
LUCKY_DICE_BLESSING.description: Gain a LOADED_DICE. Your LOADED_DICE keeps bouncing to ADJACENT enemies after the first, with the chance halving every time. It cannot bounce to the same enemy twice.

SHELL_ARMOR_BLESSING.name: Shell Armor
SHELL_ARMOR_BLESSING.description: Gain a Grotle and move to a random Turtwig region if not in one. Your STRONGEST Turtwig's passive also grants it 1/3/6 SPE_DEF upon receiving critical attacks.

SHOW_OFF.name: Show Off
SHOW_OFF.description: Does nothing. Win a game with this Wish to unlock the Show Off title.

scribble_description.EVERYONE_IS_HERE: All the additional picks are available immediately!
scribble_description.UNIQUE_STARTER: Get a random Unique at stage 1
scribble_description.OMELETTE_COOK: Get a Pokémon Egg after stage 1, 2 and 3
scribble_description.DITTO_PARTY: Start with 5 Ditto on your bench. Ditto cannot be found in the shop and cannot be sold.
scribble_description.GOTTA_CATCH_EM_ALL: Some Pokémon can be caught before each PvE round
scribble_description.TECHNOLOGIC: Choose between 3 tools at stage 2 and 4
scribble_description.FREE_MARKET: Pokémon are bought and sold for 0 GOLD
scribble_description.SHINY_HUNTER: Wild PvE encounters at stage 1, 9 and 14 are shiny
scribble_description.DO_IT_ALL_YOURSELF: Start with a copy of your avatar. Lower rarity avatars get additional max HP and starting gold.
scribble_description.SMEARGLE_PACK: Open a booster and pick one of them as your starter.
scribble_description.FIRST_PARTNER: Choose your starter Pokémon. You get a copy of this unit every stage up to stage 10.
scribble_description.SLAMINGO: All items are dropped when a Pokémon is put on the bench. Starts with 4 random components.
scribble_description.BLOOD_MONEY: Every KO gives 1 GOLD (excluding clones and spawns). No extra income from interests.
scribble_description.TOWN_FESTIVAL: You always get an encounter in town and all the carousel items are free.
scribble_description.HIGH_ROLLER: Shops have a chance to contain Hatch at stages 0-10, Unique at stages 10-20 and Legendary after stage 20.
scribble_description.REGIONAL_SPECIALTIES: Your current region types count towards your synergies. After changing region, your team tastes a local dish.
scribble_description.GO_BIG_OR_GO_HOME: Units gain 5 max HP and grow in size at every stage.
scribble_description.FAMILY_OUTING: Pokémon from the same family all count towards synergy levels.
scribble_description.UNOWN_SPELL: Unowns are spectating your fights and are casting spells on both teams each round.
scribble_description.CHOSEN_ONES: The add picks you choose evolve immediately and gain bonus stats.
scribble_description.PLAY_TEST: Play Test Mode: Summon the board from Team Planner
scribble_description.HALLOWEEN: Everyone is GHOST 8. GHOST 16 summons Ghost
scribble_description.KAIJU_BATTLE: Every Pokémon that is not MONSTER gains the MONSTER type. The HP gain is tripled.
scribble_description.AVATAR: Every Pokémon that is not {{type}} gains the {{type}} type.
scribble_description.LIGHT_SHOW: Every 3 stages, Smeargle draws a glowing shape on your board and you choose a second one. Pokémon starting a fight on a lit cell gain that shape's bonus:
scribble_description.JUGGERNAUT: Pick a Pokémon — the Juggernaut. The shop keeps offering 1 STAR copies of it. Drag a copy onto the Juggernaut to permanently boost its HP and other stats!
scribble_description.OVERTIME: Everyone starts with 200 HP and can reach level 10.
scribble_description.SIX_PACK: Pokémon can hold up to 6 items instead of 3. More items and components can be found throughout the game.
scribble_description.EVOLUTION_LAB: Welcome to the Evolution Lab! Every Pokémon can be found here, but the lab follows its own rules...

town_encounter_description.XATU: Xatu gives a TREASURE_BOX to all players. You wonder what's inside.
town_encounter_description.KANGASKHAN: Kangashkhan sells complete craftable items for {{cost}} GOLD
town_encounter_description.DUSKULL: Duskull proposes coins that increase your long term money income
town_encounter_description.MEOWTH: Meowth proposes AMULET_COIN that let you earn GOLD from kills but reduce your max interest
town_encounter_description.MAROWAK: Marowak makes the next PvE fight more difficult
town_encounter_description.WOBBUFFET: Wobbuffet let you recycle the items hold by a Pokémon into their base components
town_encounter_description.CROAGUNK: Croagunk let you swap an unused item to another one of the same category
town_encounter_description.SPINDA: Spinda changes the direction of rotation of the carousel randomly (and inverses user control sus)
town_encounter_description.REGIROCK: Regirock grants all players 15 additional HP
town_encounter_description.MUNCHLAX: Munchlax brought a PICNIC_SET for everyone
town_encounter_description.SABLEYE: Sableye proposes synergy gems that increase your synergies levels
town_encounter_description.CELEBI: Celebi predicts the next PvE fight will be shiny

faq.official_game_answer: No, this is a fan game; made by fans, for fans. All rights/credits to The Pokémon Company.
faq.how_pokemon_evolve_answer: You need 3 copies of the same Pokémon to get the evolution. The 3 Pokémon will merge to give the evolved Pokémon. Hatch Pokémon that come from eggs evolve automatically with time every 5 stages.
faq.income_answer: You get 5 gold per round whether you draw, win or lose. You get 1 bonus income per 10 gold saved. A maximum of 5 bonus income accrued at 50 saved gold. You get 1 bonus gold if you win. If you win multiple times, you will also gain extra gold; one bonus gold for every victory/defeat, up to 5 bonus gold for 5 streak wins / 5 streak defeat. Wins/Defeats during PvE stages are not taken into account.
faq.collection: What is the purpose of the collection/boosters ?
faq.collection_answer: When opening boosters, you unlock Pokémon emotes in your personal collection. In case you find duplicates, you get shards instead that you can spend to buy other emotes of that Pokémon in the Collection tab. Emotes are customizations that you can use to incarnate a Pokémon as your avatar, change its default portrait or use to communicate with other players ingame. Everyone will see the emotes that you picked for your Pokémon. Moreover, if you have selected a shiny emotion, the Pokémon will appear shiny to everyone else.
faq.avatars: How do I get new avatars ?
faq.avatars_answer: When unlocking a Pokémon emotion, it will be available in your profile avatar list. You will be able to select it as your avatar.
faq.boosters_answer: You gain boosters each time you level up.
faq.level_answer: You gain experience each time you finish a game. The better your final rank, the more experience you will gain.
faq.mythical: How do I get unique / legendary Pokémon ?
faq.mythical_answer: On stages 10 and 20, portals with synergy symbols will appear. Entering a portal will give the opportunity to select one of six powerful Pokémon, with each symbol guaranteeing a synergy of one of the Pokémon. If no portal is entered, all Pokémon options will be entirely random. Symbols are determined by the synergy levels reached by each remaining player, with 4 symbols per player chosen randomly from a pool of one symbol per each of their reached synergy levels.
faq.ditto_answer: Ditto creates a plain copy of the unit you hover and drop it over. Each Pokémon in shop has a 0.5% chance to be a Ditto at every roll. You can't copy unique and hatch Pokémon.
faq.items_answer: You can gain item components by winning PvE rounds or picking one in an item carousel. You can combine two item components to create a powerful tier 2 item. Every Pokémon can hold up to 3 items. The crafting list of all items is available in the wiki, in the items section.
faq.reconnect: I got disconnected from an ongoing game/room, how do I reconnect?
faq.reconnect_answer: Try reloading (F5 key). If that doesn't work, go back to pokemon-auto-chess.com, reauthenticate if needed and go back to main lobby, and try looking for your game under the "In Game" tab or in the corresponding gamemode. There should be a green "Reconnect" button next to your game room.
faq.bots_answer: Bots are created by other players. Bots are theme-based, a Mewtwo bot will always have an Mewtwo in its team at a certain time in the game. Bots have a list of predefined teams at each stage.
faq.create_bot: Can i create my own bot ?
faq.create_bot_answer: Sure. You'll need to be at least level 40 to unlock the Bot Builder gadget. You can use it to create and submit your bot, it will be sent in the #bot-creation channel on Discord for a review by the bot reviewers team.
faq.elo: How does the elo system work ?
faq.elo_answer: The elo system in Pokémon Auto Chess works the same as in other elo based games like Chess, Lol, Starcraft etc... To gain elo points, you need to beat other players. The higher your opponent's elo, the more elo you will gain by defeating them, and vice versa. If you don't play at least 3 games within the last 20 days, your elo will start to decay (-5 elo/day).
faq.missing_points: I didn't get elo points in my last game, why ?
faq.missing_points_answer: Only Ranked game mode enables elo gains and losses.
faq.damage: What are the special damages and physical damages ?
faq.damage_answer: Auto attacks mostly deal Physical damage, while Abilities mostly deal Special damage. Some abilities however can deal true damage or physical damage.
faq.shiny: How do you get shiny Pokémon ?
faq.shiny_answer: By unlocking or buying a shiny Pokémon emotion in your collection. Select that shiny emotion, then you will get that one Pokémon as a shiny ingame.

data.tiers_by_level_description: The odds of getting a certain rarity of Pokémon in your shop changes with your player level. The higher the level, the higher the rarity and the cost in the shop.
data.experience_by_rank_description: You gain experience points at the end of each game based on your final rank. Every 1000 XP, you level up and gain one booster.

data.explorer_bonus_rate_description: The rarity of the Pokémon sent on a Letter delivery influences what they bring back.
data.defense_calculation_description: Damage after reduction = Damage / (1+(0.05*DEF)), rounded up. DEF works for PHYSICAL, SPE_DEF for SPECIAL.
data.speed_calculation_description: SPEED influences the delay between every action of your Pokémon: movement, attack, casting ability. The delay is computed like this: Delay = 1000 / (0.4 + 0.007 * Speed). So at 0 SPEED a Pokémon does 0.4 attacks per second, and at the maximum SPEED of 300, it does 2.5 attacks per second. Some abilities or effects have a lower delay or a fixed delay.
data.luck_description: LUCK increases your chances in all draws, whether for critical hits, dodges, applying statuses ON_HIT or any other effect mentioned with the [LK] symbol.
data.luck_formula: Luck affects probabilities with this formula: P = baseP ^ (1 - luck/100) ; for example, a Pokémon with 10% crit chance and 50 luck will actually have 0.1^(1-50/100) = ~31.62 % crit chance
data.round_damage_calculation_description: The damage inflicted to player after losing a round is computed like this: Round damage = (stage level / 2) + (number of opponent's Pokémon alive) ; rounded up, clones/spawns do not count
data.pool_size_per_category_description: The Pokémon you find in shops are taken from a pool shared by all players. The number of specimens of each Pokémon in the pool depends on its rarity and its number of evolution stages.

double_up.shared_hp: Your health pool is shared with your partner. You take half the usual damage per fight, but at the end of each round your team takes the worse of the two losses.
double_up.trade_desc: Drag and drop items or components onto Croagunk to trade with your partner. Trading is only available during the preparation phase. (If you place an item on Croagunk but your partner doesn't offer a counter-trade before the battle phase begins, the item is returned to your bench). Left-click a placed item to cancel it. You will see your partners item proposal hovering below Croagunk, vice versa.
double_up.trade_rules: Only basic components and their crafted items are tradable. Scarves, tools, and shiny items are excluded. Trades must be item-for-item or component-for-component — mismatched trades are cancelled.
double_up.prison_bottle_desc: You start with a Prison Bottle. Drag it onto a benched Pokémon to send it to your partners bench during the preparation phase. Items held by the sent Pokémon will be removed before sending. Depending on the Pokémon's rarity, there is a cooldown before the Prison Bottle reappears, before you can send it again. UNIQUE and LEGENDARY Pokemon are too heavy for Hoopa ... and EGGs are too fragile! Cannot be sent!
double_up.reinforcements_desc: If you defeat your opponent before your partner finishes their round, your Pokémon will join their battle as reinforcements. Active synergies, itemization, and permanent stats from your team will carry over. Your Pokémon will not contribute to or gain any new synergy effects from your partner's team. There is a 3-second delay before reinforcements arrive. Unowns are too shy, to reinforce.
double_up.shared_pve_desc: During PvE rounds, you and your partner fight side by side in a single battle against strong encounters. They adapt to your team's board and scale of your total board power. Do not sit on your gold and items!
double_up.gift_desc: At stages 15–16 and 25–26. Send your partner a gift bundle containing Pokémon, gems, items, and more — paid or free. Make sure your partner has a free bench slot before sending a Pokémon! Make sure you have enough Gold! Gifts can turn the tide of the game, so choose wisely.
double_up.finale_desc: You and your partner face each other in one last friendly battle. Your team victory is already secured! If the finale lands on a carousel or wild battle stage, those still play out first — the duel is the next player-versus-player round.
double_up.lobby_desc: Open a lobby, add bots if needed, and select a partner. Once both players in a pair click Ready, they are locked in and cannot be selected by others. If your partner gets stolen before readying, you'll need to find a new partner and ready again. No elo is gained or lost. No elo lost or gained. Good Luck! technical_terms_definitions.ADJACENT_IN_THE_SAME_ROW: the tiles directly to the left and right of a unit
technical_terms_definitions.BOARD_EFFECT: A Board Effect is an effect on a cell of the board that influences all units standing on it, no matter the team, until the end of the fight. Board effects can be cleared by certain abilities.
technical_terms_definitions.CONE: shooting at a 90 degrees angle in front of the unit, centered on the target
technical_terms_definitions.FLY_AWAY: Moves to the safest spot while still being at RANGE of an enemy
technical_terms_definitions.IGNITE: Spending a FIRE_SHARD on a Pokémon can set its spirit alight for one round, granting it SHIELD, SPEED and healing player HP on every KO. Requires FIRE 8 or the Soul Blaze Wish.
technical_terms_definitions.INIMITABLE: An ability is inimitable if it cannot be copied and used by another Pokémon.
technical_terms_definitions.ON_HIT: On Hit effects trigger when a unit is hit by an attack or an ability. They are triggered even if target has SHIELD, but not if the target dodges or has PROTECT.
technical_terms_definitions.ON_ATTACK: On Attack effects trigger when a unit makes a basic attack on another unit that is still alive, at the time the attack is supposed to hit, whether the attack actually hits or not.
technical_terms_definitions.STRONGEST: Strongest is defined as, by order of priority: 1. Number of items held, 2. Unit tier, 3. Unit rarity
